# Action Notes: sbom-generation-comparison.yml

Source SBOM generation run:
[44914721560](https://github.com/denisecase/section-comment-outline/actions/runs/44914721560)

All three generators include development dependencies,
as declared in `.github/sbom-generators.toml`.

Package records are components in CycloneDX and packages in SPDX.
Their counts differ more than the PURLs do:

| Generator |             Package records | Records with a PURL | Distinct PURLs |
| --------- | --------------------------: | ------------------: | -------------: |
| **npm**   |                         137 |                 137 |            137 |
| **Syft**  | 155 (CycloneDX), 156 (SPDX) |                 155 |            142 |
| **Trivy** |                         138 |                 136 |            136 |

Syft's SPDX output has one more record, `.`, without a PURL.
Trivy's two records without a PURL describe the scanned directory
and `package-lock.json`.
Several records can carry one PURL,
so the PURL counts are lower than the record counts.

In both CycloneDX and SPDX formats,
the three generators share **136 distinct PURLs**.

npm and Syft also list the **repo PURL**,
`pkg:npm/comment-section-outline@0.2.1`.

Trivy describes the scanned directory without a PURL
and does not list the scanned repository package.

Syft lists **five additional GitHub Actions PURLs**.
on **18 records**.
Every file action is a different record.

Together, these account for all differences
between the PURL sets in this generation run.
